summary: Firefox improved how WebGL and WebGPU share and recycle graphics textures, helping reduce unnecessary GPU memory use and resource churn. It also changed DMA-BUF shared textures so they no longer retain Vulkan objects, making GPU-resource ownership and cleanup safer across platforms. Additional fixes addressed a WebGPU issue and clarified default state on macOS for more reliable static analysis; these are mostly behind-the-scenes improvements with no visible UI change.
